scope: Inspección estática de loaders, definición de mazmorra y mapas exportados; ningún encuentro ni actor se creó

definition_membership.native_method: aKU.cno() returns int[] eiQ; bam passes these references to bpN; bpU resolves them through the monster registry for catalogue/name search.
definition_membership.meaning_limit: The inspected path does not expose a room index, spawn count, monster grade/level, or spawn coordinates.

maps_and_doors.combat_map_scope: Static walkable surfaces only; source explicitly excludes dynamic actors, line-of-sight, and fight placement policy.

conclusion: The available catalog establishes definition membership and room-sector links, not per-room encounter composition. Exact combat population needs another native source or a captured, successful in-client instance traversal.
